handoffs.summary: Genesis brainstorming complete. Product vision defined. 5 modules scoped. Tech stack confirmed. Two real FFB receipts analyzed — confirmed MPOB formula (Price/mt = Price_1% x Graded_OER%), rejected unofficial dealer formula (CPO x 0.2? x 0.7?). OER grading identified as the real information asymmetry. Trinity validated: 8.4/10 for prototype-first strategy. Master Prompt at v1.2.
decisions_locked: Primary user: Malaysian oil palm smallholder
Data backbone: MPOB BEPI scraper, 2x daily
Stack: Flutter + Riverpod + Firestore + Python + GitHub Actions
Prototype first: public, read-only, zero auth, GitHub Pages
Prototype scope: Dashboard + Calculator + 30-day chart + BM/EN toggle
Feedback button on prototype (3 preset options)
Module 5 (Dealer Map): deferred to last phase
Sales Journal: local storage default, cloud opt-in
Scraper health monitor + fallback from Day 1
Rejected formula: CPO x 0.2? x 0.7? permanently excluded
OER grading is the real problem, not CPO price
next_steps: Build Phase 1: MPOB BEPI scraper in Python
Set up GitHub Actions cron (8:30am + 4:30pm MYT)
handoffs.context: Two real receipts analyzed: PV-85935 (17 Mar, OER 18%, RM 770) and VMF-8951 (10 Apr, OER 18.25%, RM 860). Different dealers, significant price variance confirms need for transparency tool.
